FSI scatter and 2x2 framework figures

Sec 4.6 frontier decomposition: per-kappa cross-sectional R2 (0.64-0.65), lambda=0.33 per-kappa slope convention, kappa-alone pooled R2 (0.37), turnover~FSI R2 (0.73), partial corr(FSI, deg | TO) ~0.25
Robustness / statistical significance: exact market-level sign-flip test pooling all eight frontier interventions vs MomentumSort (mean +0.11, p = 0.008; Wilcoxon p = 0.015)
Robustness: headline means excluding smallest universe GRC N=50 (Ridge_Slow 0.45 vs MomSort 0.36; frontier band 0.42-0.47)

Documented negative control (not in paper): importance-weighted FSI does NOT add within-strategy cross-market resolution (R2 <= 0.06 vs turnover, ~0 vs degradation). Confirms FSI resolution is at the feature-set level; fast-weight share is uncorrelated with cross-market turnover.

Tree-EMA on the main OOS sample (2021-2023, 15 markets): XGBoost 0.24 -> walk-forward EMA 0.35 (sort parity, not frontier); best post-hoc fixed alpha=0.2 gives 0.45 at 12% TO. Replaces the post-2020 validation 0.53 claim, which does not replicate. MomentumSort reproduces expAX exactly (pipeline fidelity).

Robustness: value-weighted construction preserves the hierarchy (Ridge_Slow 0.40 > MomSort 0.31 > Ridge_All 0.30 at kappa=3; wins 10/15, positive 14/15). Uses drift-adjusted weight turnover, so turnover levels are not comparable to the equal-weight name-count convention.
